item.title: Version 1.3.2
item.description: Menu bar: the View menu lists the tool tabs, and the Edit menu has a submenu for each tool with all its buttons (for Keyboard Maestro). Ref Check now reports sound in the stems that isn't in the reference. Clear button on every tool, Tempo Map runs as soon as you drop a file, Timecode always shows two-digit hours, and Video Converter explains the Accessibility permission on screen.
